newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA COMMERCIAL BANK GETS CHASE MANHATTAN AWARD.
newsitem.headline: RIGA COMMERCIAL BANK GETS CHASE MANHATTAN AWARD.

text.p: U.S. banking giant Chase Manhattan is to give an award to Riga Commercial Bank as its best correpondent bank for 1996, the Latvian bank said on Wednesday.

Riga Commerical Bank's head of information office, Juris Puncals, told Reuters that a special ceremony handing over the prize will take place on Thursday, March 13, when top Chase Manhattan representatives will visit Riga.
He said the award was a prize for Riga Commercial Bank being Chase Manhattan's highest quality correspondent bank in the world.
